decisions.reason: The modular processing concept shows a quantified customer saving of over 600,000 euros per year, which clears the aspiration level, and a growing firm has the slack to keep developing it.
The mobile slow-speed shredder is close to the core offer and has kept its own page for two years, so there is no shortfall that would trigger search for other uses of its resources.
A named reference customer and quantified savings show the concept meeting aspirations, and it fits the firm's stated direction toward modular solutions.
The newly launched slow-speed shredders are a core-adjacent line with their own page, and the growing firm's slack lets it carry them while results are still uncertain.
The spiral shaft screens are recent and without results yet, but they extend the firm's screening range, and growth and investment give the slack to carry them for now.
